System blueprint

An evidence-led market intelligence system

Combine approved market sources and internal context into a reviewable research workspace. Track where evidence came from, when it was collected, and what your team can reasonably conclude before using it in a commercial decision.

Level 2Choose a capability

Market information arrives in different formats and with uneven reliability. Teams need a bounded question, authorized sources, traceable records, and an explicit review process instead of treating a generated summary as verified evidence.

Useful outputs

  • A research specification with approved sources, exclusions, and collection constraints.
  • A structured evidence dataset with source dates and quality notes.
  • A reviewed intelligence brief and selected activation views.
  • A refresh, quality review, and operating handover.

Inputs we need

  • A specific market question, target regions, segments, and research decision owner.
  • Approved public or internal sources with provider licenses and collection permissions.
  • Required fields, refresh expectations, comparison criteria, and evidence quality examples.
Level 3Explore a focus

Define the research boundary

Agree the decision, audience, questions, source permissions, provider licenses, and exclusions. Choose a representative sample and define the fields and confidence notes needed.

Collect and structure approved evidence

Use supported collection or data products only for permitted sources. Normalize records, retain source URLs and dates, and expose missing, conflicting, and stale evidence.

Implementation outputs

  • A source-linked market dataset with documented confidence and freshness.
  • A reviewed research brief separating observations, hypotheses, and limitations.
  • An intelligence workspace and maintenance guide with clear exception ownership.

Human expertise

Own the judgment.

Domain experts approve the source boundary, evaluate representative evidence, and own interpretation and commercial conclusions. Operators monitor source changes and licensing or access constraints.

AI assistance

Support the process.

AI can extract candidate fields, classify evidence, and prepare cited summaries. Unsupported facts, conflicting sources, and uncertain conclusions remain visible for human review.

Required-field completeness ↗Lead qualification rate ↗Average task completion time ↗Automation outcome success rate ↗
  • Market, region, segment, company, product category, and source type.
  • Evidence date, field completeness, confidence, and source agreement.
  • Research question, comparison criterion, approved inference, and review status.
  • Confirm permissions, licenses, provider plans, APIs, and source-specific limits.
  • Test missing fields, source changes, duplicates, and unsupported model outputs.
  • Approve a representative dataset and documented refresh and recovery process.
